reason: Rings marks on a live page, screenshots it and reads the measured values back from the DOM. Every branch is a Playwright call on a running Enso; its decisions (crop, plain names, session shot selection) are split out and tested (#838).
Turns a mark target into a Playwright Locator, recursing through `within`. A Locator only exists on a live page, and an untargeted one proves nothing until a capture resolves it (#838).
Annotates a live page, screenshots the viewport or a region through an overlay box, then clears the annotations. Every branch is a page call; the region arithmetic is regionCrop, tested (#838).

Wheels a live page until a windowed transcript row is drawn, then wheels it near the top over its own column, measuring after each turn. Every branch is a mouse or box call on a running Enso; there is no decision to split out and test (#417).

Starts the dev stack, waits on its ports, opens the browser and runs each wanted feature's session. Its decisions (options, wanted features, scratch setup) are split out and tested; what is left is process and browser lifecycle (#838).

Fully covered, so its CRAP is its cyclomatic complexity: one `case` per observation kind. `scripts/docs/observations.ts` reads those `case` blocks to generate the observations page, so splitting the switch breaks the generator. Also in complexity-baseline.json.

One local PR review end to end: gh pr view, a git worktree at the head, bun install and the comment list in a credential-less subprocess, docker agent run, the status comment upsert. Every branch is a gh, git or docker call against a real pull request; its decisions (planReview, lastReviewedHeadOf, statusCommentBody, readReviewWorkflow, fillPrompt, decideToolCall) are split out and tested, and the whole path ran as a dry run on #958 (#981).
